facts.fact: Emtel states its data centre was first certified by the Mauritius Standards Bureau against MS ISO/IEC 27001 in 2013 and upgraded to the 2013 version in 2015 (certifier: Mauritius Standards Bureau); the document carries no date of its own and its published date, 2019-11-26, is derived from its posting path, so the event dates are 2013 and 2015.

systems.owner: Government of Mauritius, under the Mauritius Standards Bureau Act

note: ISO 9001 quality management certification, Emtel's 2003 BSI certificate and the business excellence award are not facts; BSI is a certifier abroad.
